summary: This is an environment configuration file that sets up variables for a Joomla 3 installation running in Docker. It defines database credentials, admin user details, service versions, and port mappings that the application needs to start up and run properly.

explanations.2: CONTAINER_PREFIX names the Docker container—it's a label to identify this particular Joomla setup among potentially many containers.
explanations.15: MYSQL_PORT=3303 exposes the database on port 3303 instead of the default 3306, so it won't conflict if you're running other databases.
explanations.21: WEB_PORT=8083 makes the Joomla website accessible on port 8083 of your local machine (like http://localhost:8083).
